import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

print(f"Loaded train {len(train)}, test {len(test)}, sample_sub {len(sample_sub)}")

# Find target column name for sample submission
target_col_name = None
for col in sample_sub.columns:
    if "prediction" in col.lower() or "insult" in col.lower():
        target_col_name = col
        break

if target_col_name is None:
    target_col_name = "prediction"


# Define improved comment cleaning function - preserves emphasis signals
def clean_comment(c):
    if isinstance(c, str):
        # Remove surrounding quotes but preserve internal content
        c = c.strip('"')
        # Normalize unicode escapes
        try:
            c = c.encode().decode("unicode_escape")
        except:
            pass
        # Lowercase only alphabetic chars to catch emphasis while preserving punctuation
        cleaned = []
        for char in c:
            if char.isalpha():
                cleaned.append(char.lower())
            else:
                cleaned.append(char)
        return "".join(cleaned).strip()
    return ""


# Clean comments
train["Comment"] = train["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)
test["Comment"] = test["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)

# Character n-grams: Bigrams AND Trigrams for better insult detection
char_vectorizer = __import__("sklearn").feature_extraction.text.TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 3),
    max_df=0.95,
    min_df=2,
    max_features=30000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Word-level TF-IDF
word_vectorizer = __import__("sklearn").feature_extraction.text.TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_df=0.95,
    min_df=2,
    stop_words="english",
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit all vectorizers on full training data
X_char_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train["Comment"])
X_word_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train["Comment"])

# Combine features with increased dimensionality
X_train_combined = np.hstack([X_char_train.toarray(), X_word_train.toarray()])
y_train_combined = train["Insult"].values.astype(float)

# Create proper hold-out validation split (model NEVER trains on this)
X_train_val, X_test_val, y_train_valid, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined,
    y_train_combined,
    test_size=0.3,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_combined,
)

# Train LightGBM model on validation-excluded training data
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_val, label=y_train_valid)
model = lgb.train(lgb_params, train_data, num_boost_round=5000)

# Calculate validation AUC on genuinely unseen hold-out data
y_train_valid_pred_proba = model.predict(X_train_val)[:, 1]
auc_validation = roc_auc_score(y_train_valid, y_train_val_pred_proba)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {auc_validation:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
X_test_combined = np.hstack(
    [
        char_vectorizer.transform(test["Comment"]).toarray(),
        word_vectorizer.transform(test["Comment"]).toarray(),
    ]
)
y_test_proba = model.predict(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
y_test_proba = np.clip(y_test_proba, 0, 1)

# Prepare submission file matching sample submission format
submission_preds = y_test_proba.tolist()

if target_col_name in sample_sub.columns:
    # Extract only the prediction column for submission
    target_idx = sample_sub.columns.get_loc(target_col_name)

    if sample_sub.shape[1] > 1:
        # Keep only the target column for submission
        sub_df = sample_sub.iloc[:, target_idx:].copy()
    else:
        sub_df = sample_sub.copy()
else:
    # No matching column found - create default submission
    sub_df = pd.DataFrame(index=test.index)

# Set predictions to first column
sub_df[target_col_name] = submission_preds

# Save submission to required location
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)

print("Submission saved to", SUBMISSION_PATH)
print(f"AUC-ROC Score: {auc_validation:.6f}")
